stem.text: Lithium reacts with nitrogen at room temperature to form solid $\text{Li}_3\text{N}$.
Three vessels of equal volume are connected by taps 1 and 2 as shown.

stem.alt: Three connected vessels: left vessel labelled evacuated, tap 1, middle vessel labelled N2(g) + 3H2(g) ⇌ 2NH3(g), tap 2, right vessel containing solid Li.

stem.text: At the start, taps 1 and 2 are closed, the left-hand vessel is evacuated, the middle vessel has the indicated reaction at equilibrium and the right-hand vessel contains lithium only.
Which action would allow the equilibrium mixture to contain the **most** ammonia?
